live_issue.title: [v0.92.1][podcast][51.b] Publish and validate production hosting, RSS, enclosures, and playback
live_issue.body:
Split from #51. Part of #51. Depends on terminal #261 (51.a) and terminal episode-package input.

## Outcome

Publish and independently validate the production podcast hosting surface: stable HTTPS media enclosures, the canonical RSS feed, HTTP metadata and byte-range behavior, and representative desktop/mobile feed and playback proof.

## Scope

- Production feed at https://agent-logic.ai/podcast/feed.xml using the approved 51.a identity packet.
- Stable HTTPS episode enclosure URLs from terminal review-ready episode packages.
- RSS 2.0 and required podcast metadata validation.
- Exact MIME type, byte length, duration, GUID, publication date, artwork, and digest reconciliation.
- HEAD/GET and 206 Partial Content proof for audio.
- Representative desktop and mobile subscription, metadata, and playback proof.
- Hosting/feed correction and rollback limited to this owned publication surface.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The canonical feed validates and contains no local, preview-only, placeholder, smoke-test, or fixture URLs.
2. Every enclosure is stable HTTPS media with correct MIME type, byte length, duration, GUID, publication date, and digest.
3. Byte-range requests return correct 206 behavior and representative desktop/mobile playback succeeds.
4. Feed, artwork, show metadata, and episode metadata match the approved 51.a packet and terminal episode input exactly.
5. Failure and rollback preserve episode source packages and prior evidence.
6. Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings.

## Dependencies

- Terminal #261 (51.a) identity/artwork/metadata/mailbox-readiness child.
- Terminal review-ready episode-package input from agent-logic/agent-design-language#342.
- Part of #51.

## Non-Goals

- No show-identity decision or artwork redesign.
- No directory account action or submission.
- No public launch announcement.
- No episode production.

## Graph

`split_from: #51`; `part_of: #51`; `depends_on: terminal #261 (51.a), terminal episode-package input from agent-logic/agent-design-language#342`; prerequisite for 51.c.
